rationale: The "identical units" argument fails on magnitude rather than units — TS_MIN(xrd/at) is typically 0–0.05 while intan/at routinely runs 0.1–0.6, so the net leg is arithmetically dominated by −intan/at and the signal collapses into a raw-scaled restatement of the archived CashCheapMinusAcquiredIntangibles rather than a genuine test of a combined organic-minus-acquired position.

A modest but legitimate single-lever attribution test on the archive's best family, with a sound secondary motivation (industry demeaning dissolves the zero-R&D mass point instead of stacking imputed firms at the global bottom), though it remains an ablation of CashCheapWithKnowledgeFloor rather than a new mechanism.

Testing conjunctive versus additive combination form is a real and unexplored design question, but the MIN operator interacts badly with the large tie mass in IND_RANK(TS_MIN(xrd/at,5)) for non-reporting firms, so a substantial fraction of firms will be capped at an identical tie value and the short leg's composition may be close to arbitrary — a diagnostic to check before interpreting any result.

Internally consistent and correctly sign-flipped off the archived negative result, but TS_RANK of a firm's own enterprise-value-to-capital ratio over five years is largely a price-level-relative-to-own-history variable, so the construct is close to the published 52-week-high/long-horizon momentum effect and the composite reduces to the well-known value-plus-momentum blend rather than an intangible-accounting mechanism.

The difference between the rank of (ceq+R&D stock)/ME and the rank of ceq/ME is essentially a monotone transform of R&D capital scaled by market equity, making this a rediscovery of the well-documented R&D-to-market-value anomaly (Chan-Lakonishok-Sougiannis) dressed as a reclassification wedge.

The 2x2 attribution framing is appealing, but cumulative R&D share of augmented capital is cross-sectionally near-collinear with the five-year R&D-intensity floor already used in CashCheapWithKnowledgeFloor, so this is likely a cosmetic re-parameterization of the archived winner and, standalone, the R&D-intensity leg is itself a known anomaly.
